Who I Am

BUILD THE SYSTEM THAT RUNS THE BUSINESS.

I'm Amine Elaouam — also known as Amine Loading — a self-taught product builder and e-commerce entrepreneur based in Morocco, currently finishing my Baccalaureate in Experimental Sciences while building businesses and software on the side.

Building, experimenting and learning online since age 9 — starting with gaming and cybersecurity, moving into development, design, and marketing, then into e-commerce. Today my main project is Ecom OS, where I've moved from operating e-commerce businesses to building the infrastructure that runs them.

What I Build

Ecom OS

Ecom OS is an all-in-one SaaS operating system for e-commerce and COD operations, built especially for Moroccan sellers, brands and teams. It covers orders, confirmation, shipping, CRM, inventory, finance, analytics, Meta Ads, teams, integrations, billing, admin tooling, audit logs, WhatsApp automation and an AI assistant — all in one workspace.
